<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a crafting resource smelted at [[Furnace II]] or [[Furnace III]] by processing [[coal]]. It is primarily used in the production of [[Steel ingot|steel]], though can also be ground into a [[Graphite powder|powder]] for alchemical use once studied. To unlock this you must research Precious Metals under the Building tech tree.
